sheets.note: Its pixel grid sets the scale of the whole game: one art pixel of this sheet is one game pixel (about 2.86 picture pixels; Pip stands about 49 game pixels tall).

sheets.title: Level inspiration: the Whiskerworks shipyard with the SS Mewoh-1
sheets.use: the look of a level: platforms, scaffolding, signs, sleeping cats, cheese (not cut yet)

sheets.title: Level props: platforms, girders, pipes, machines, crates, signs, cats and ship parts
sheets.use: props for the levels, on a green ground (not cut yet)

sheets.title: Cover: Pip, the cat, the Holy Cow and MEGA-MJAU's fortress (title art still reads "Star Whiskers")
sheets.use: the cover and title screen; the look of the cast

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon props 1: ground and platforms (glossy, thin and matte crust, floating chunks, Swiss ledges), craters and holes, rocks, plants, decals
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the level's ground, platforms, pits and holes (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 7 rows. Missing: "crater cap L" (row 3 has 6 of 7). Two labels are garbled ("hole oval", "wall cap"). The paw prints came out pink-purple: they would be eaten by the magenta key. (A first take, made at medium quality with a looser style block, was softer and noisier and is not kept.)

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon props 2: milk bubbles (every state of the pop), the curd boat, milk things, pickups and movables, signs, the builders' leftovers
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the bubble platforms, the curd, cheese pickups, the pushable wheels, the box and the cat bed, signs (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 6 rows, every item there. The curds have a rosy tint in their shading (check against the magenta key). One label reads "nug" for "mug".

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon props 3: the pumping station: pipes, the main pipeline, valves and controls, pumps and tanks, doors, the inside, lights, tools
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the pumping station and its puzzles: valve wheels, levers, plates, gauges, pumps and tanks, the pump housing, the pipe map and its torn pieces, the plaque and the old photo (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 8 rows. Missing: "map piece 2" (three of the four pieces are there). The piston caps and the tanks' sight glass are tinted pink.

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon backgrounds, outdoors 1: the sky with the broken Milky Way (top panel) and the far cheese mountains (bottom panel)
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the slowest background layers outdoors: each panel is two screens wide (3840 x 1080), the sky is opaque, the mountains stand on magenta (not cut yet)
sheets.note: Two panels of 3840 x 1080 picture pixels (960 x 270 game pixels). The seams (left edge into right edge) are not checked yet.

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon backgrounds, outdoors 2: the middle plain with the far pumping station (top panel) and the near cliffs and pipes (bottom panel)
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the middle and near layers outdoors, on magenta (not cut yet)
sheets.note: Two panels of 3840 x 1080 picture pixels. The seams are not checked yet; the middle panel's ground and the near panel's top edge meet at the middle of the sheet.

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon backgrounds, inside the pumping station: the half-painted back wall (top panel) and the deep machine hall (bottom panel)
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the interior layers of the pumping station: the wall is opaque, the deep hall stands on magenta (not cut yet)
sheets.note: Two panels of 3840 x 1080 picture pixels. The seams are not checked yet.

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon foregrounds, outdoors: hanging stalactites, corner rocks, pillars, big low shapes, mist
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the front pass outdoors: pieces drawn in front of Pip, which fade where he walks behind them (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 5 rows, all 31 pieces. The mist banks are pale lavender-pink and would be eaten by the magenta key: they need a cleaner cut (or a redraw).

sheets.title: Bubbling Moon foregrounds, inside the pumping station: hanging pipes and cables, machine edges, beams, railings, steam
sheets.source: Claude, through the image API (gpt-image-2.6-flare, high; tools/sheets.mjs)
sheets.use: the front pass inside the pumping station: close pipes, cables, machine edges, beams, railings, steam (not cut yet)
sheets.note: 5 rows, all 31 pieces. The steam, the dust beam and the milk haze are pink-tinted (they would be eaten by the magenta key): they need a cleaner cut or a redraw.
